definitions.explanation: The male reproductive organ of a flower, which produces and holds pollen. Contrasted with the {雌|め}しべ (pistil), the female part.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}の{雄|お}しべを{観察|かんさつ}する。
examples.english: to observe the stamen of a flower.

examples.japanese: {雄|お}しべの{先|さき}には{花粉|かふん}がついている。
examples.english: Pollen is attached to the tip of the stamen.

examples.japanese: {理科|りか}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で、{雄|お}しべと{雌|め}しべの{働|はたら}きを{習|なら}った。
examples.english: In science class we learned the roles of the stamen and the pistil.

notes:
The male reproductive part of a flower, which produces and holds pollen. Usually written in kana, or as {雄|お}しべ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄|お}しべと{雌|め}しべ: stamen and pistil
- {雄|お}しべの{花粉|かふん}: the pollen of the stamen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雌|め}しべ: pistil — the female reproductive organ of a flower
- {花粉|かふん}: pollen — the powder produced by the stamen
